Ethnic bias in stop and search

2025-09-11

Load the data:

data <- load.stop.search.data()
## Rows: 3628 Columns: 11
## ── Column specification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Delimiter: ","
## chr (5): police_force, officer_defined_ethnicity, previous_financial_year, c...
## dbl (6): number_of_stops, number_of_arrests, asian_perc, black_perc, asian_p...
## 
## ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data.
## ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.
areas <- load.areas.data()
## st_as_s2(): dropping Z and/or M coordinate

Fit the model:

set.seed(34982)
model <- fit.single.model(data)

Temporal Plot:

plot.temporal(model)

plot.temporal(model)

ggsave("posterior_ratio_plot.pdf", width=6, height=3, units="in")

Compute overall excursion sets:

overall.ex.sets <- compute.overall.excursion.sets(model, data)

ggsave("visualisations/overall_excursion_set.pdf", width=6, height=3, units="in")
plot.overall.excursion.sets <- function(excursion.sets, areas) {
  
  p1 <- areas %>%
    mutate(
      excursion.upr = police_force %in% excursion.sets$asian.upr,
      excursion.lwr = police_force %in% excursion.sets$asian.lwr,
      excursion = as.factor(excursion.upr - excursion.lwr)
    ) %>%
    ggplot() +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = excursion)) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.line = element_blank(),
          axis.text = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "none",
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(size = rel(1.0), colour = "black")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("blue", "white", "red"), breaks = -1:1) +
    ggtitle("Upper level avoiding sets for bias against Asian people (left)\n and Black people (right)")
  
  p2 <- areas %>%
    mutate(
      excursion.upr = police_force %in% excursion.sets$black.upr,
      excursion.lwr = police_force %in% excursion.sets$black.lwr,
      excursion = as.factor(excursion.upr - excursion.lwr)
    ) %>%
    ggplot() +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = excursion)) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.line = element_blank(),
          axis.text = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "none",
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(size = rel(1.0), colour = "black")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("blue", "white", "red"), breaks = -1:1) 
  
  return(p1+p2 )
}

  mutate(
    asian.f = asian.F[,police_force],
    asian.upr = ifelse(police_force %in% overall.ex.sets$asian.upr, "X", ""),
    black.probs = black.probs[police_force],
    black.f = black.F[,police_force],
    black.upr = ifelse(police_force %in% overall.ex.sets$black.upr, "X", ""),
    police_force = str_to_title(gsub("_", " ", police_force))
  )

## \end{tabular}
fit.model.pit <- function(datad, 
                            k = 0.01, 
                            prec.prior = list(prec = list(prior = "pc.prec", param = c(0.1, 0.5))),
                            ar.prior = list(prec = list(prior = "pc.prec", param = c(0.01, 0.5)),
                                            rho = list(prior = "pc.cor0", param = c(0.1, 0.5)))) {
  prec.prior.od = list(prec = list(prior = "pc.prec", param = c(0.0001, 0.5)))
  # lincomb <- get.eth.year.lincomb(datad)
  
  model <- inla(stops ~ offset(log(arrests+k)) + # ugly to have it here but makes posterior predictive checks easier
                  f(ethnicity, constr=T, hyper = prec.prior) +
                  f(force, constr=T, hyper = prec.prior) +
                  # f(zero, model = "iid", hyper = list(prec = list(initial = 1, fixed = TRUE)))+
                  f(crime, constr=T, hyper = prec.prior) +
                  f(year, model = "ar1", constr=T, hyper = ar.prior) +
                  f(year.ethnicity, model = "ar1", group = ethnicity.idx, constr=T, hyper = ar.prior) +
                  # f(year.force, model = "ar1", group = force.idx, constr=T, hyper = ar.prior) +
                  # f(year.crime, model = "ar1", group = crime.idx, constr=T, hyper = ar.prior) +
                  f(interaction(ethnicity, force), constr=T, hyper = prec.prior) +
                  f(interaction(force, crime), constr=T, hyper = prec.prior) +
                  f(interaction(ethnicity, crime), constr=T, hyper = prec.prior) +
                  f(obs, constr=T, hyper = prec.prior.od),
                data = datad,
                family = "zeroinflatedpoisson1",
                # E = arrests+k,   # prettier place to have offset, but makes posterior predictive checks more complicated
                # lincomb = lincomb,
                control.compute = list(config=T, cpo=T),
                control.predictor = list(compute = T))
  
  return(model)
}


set.seed(34983)

d1 <- data %>% filter()
model.pit <- fit.model.pit(d1)


hist(model.pit$cpo$pit)

summary(model.pit$cpo$pit)
